about: The Protection Score's bands -- ONE definition, read by the engine (engine\_shared\SI-ProtectionScore.ps1 Get-SIProtectionBand: the mails, the Risk Analysis log line) and the web app (SI.Management.Core ProtectionBands: the score cards, the wall board, the Executive overview and report, the management mail). The score is 0-100, higher is better; a band is the first one, from the top, whose 'min' the score reaches. Tone is the web app's colour family (a score, not a risk: a good band may be green); ink is the colour the mails use on white (WCAG AA). The ranges are the engine's existing bands (mirroring Microsoft's Secure Score bands) -- to confirm with the owner (REQUIREMENTS #827). The web app embeds an exact copy (pro-management\src\SI.Management.Core\ProData\DataModel); a test keeps the two equal.
